rows.label: Dorma Hound
rows.note: her prebuilt Hound; the Batoten arrives with it
rows.alt: a Dorma Model blueprint from a vanquish is the other way in

conditions: Vanquish, never convert: a converted Sister hands over no Hound.
Her Hound's Model is random among Bhaira, Dorma and Hec, and only a Dorma Hound gives the Batoten. You cannot re-roll a living Sister.
Rank 1 in the Granum Void is 25 Errant Specter kills solo, enough to spawn the Candidate. Mercy her with the Parazon; only the last player to damage her can.
A Candidate will not spawn within roughly 150-200 meters of extraction.
bonuses: Every vanquish also gives each squad member a random Hound component blueprint, tradeable toward a Dorma Model.
Unclaimed prebuilt Hounds sell in the Foundry for 20,000 credits.

disclosures.title: the Granum Void loop
disclosures.body: Mesa (press 4 and hold fire) is the near-unanimous answer, with Xoris throw-and-detonate the other standard one. Spawn the Treasurer on a 30+ Corpus survival, take the crown at the 5-7 minute mark and repeat for an endless supply.

disclosures.title: leveling the Sister
disclosures.body: She controls star chart nodes. Kill her Hounds, one always spawns at mission start and up to 3, to fill her rage and build Murmurs; about six to seven Hound mercies reveal one part of the sequence. Failing the Mercy only raises her level and she returns later. Success sends her to the Neptune Proxima.

disclosures.title: building the Hound by hand
disclosures.body: The Dorma Model needs 5 Spectral Debris, 5 Gallium, 2 Radian Sentirum and 10 Mirewinder Parallel Biode, 24h and 50,000 credits, and the Hound still needs a Core, Bracket and Stabilizer, each its own Sister blueprint. Spectral Debris drops from Errant Specters at 5%. All four parts are configured at Legs for 4,000 credits; building the Model alone gives no Hound.
